async def cleanup_loops(items, rows, cleanup):
    for item in items:
        if failed(item):
            for row in rows:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await cleanup(row)
            raise ValueError("failed")
    for item in items:
        if failed(item):
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            [await cleanup(row) for row in rows]
            raise ValueError("failed")
